faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and tooling cost for FS-130 CNC Stainless 12-Bead Dual-Spring Dome-Switch Bearing EDC?
faqs.answer: Because FS-130 utilizes our mature ready-to-use production mold (#130), the tooling and mold fee is $0.00. The wholesale MOQ is 50 pcs for blank stock orders and 100 pcs for custom 50W Fiber Laser Engraved or Deep Laser + Color Fill logo orders.

faqs.question: Can we customize our corporate or brand logo on FS-130?
faqs.answer: Yes. Note that our factory does NOT recommend surface silk-screen or UV ink printing on metal because smooth, chemically inert metal surfaces lack ink adhesion and peel off under thumb friction. Instead, we recommend two permanent methods on FS-130: (1) 50W Fiber Laser Engraving for monochrome logos (+$0.15–$0.30/pc, $0 setup, 100 pcs MOQ, $50 USD sample fee), and (2) Deep Laser Engraving + Color Fill for colored logos (+$0.35–$0.60/pc, 100–200 pcs MOQ, $80–$150 USD sample fee), where the laser carves a recessed cavity filled with cured enamel so the color never peels.

faqs.question: How are the magnets and hardware secured inside FS-130 for US CPSC 16 CFR 1262 compliance?
faqs.answer: All magnetic and mechanical assemblies (2 pcs 5*2mm/N52; 10 pcs Hardened Steel Detent Ball Ø4.08mm, 2 pcs Hardened Steel Detent Ball Ø3mm, 2 pcs Precision Coil Spring Ø3*5mmCoils 7, 1 pcs Tactile Metal Dome Switch , 1 pcs Precision Ball Bearing OD Ø12.7*ID 6.35mm) are structurally enclosed or mechanically locked using industrial two-part structural epoxy (>22 MPa shear strength) and thread-locked fasteners, passing 10× 1.5m concrete drop abuse tests under US CPSC 16 CFR Part 1262 and EU RoHS 3 / REACH directives.
